ITEM 1 | Dark green curly-leafed greens, ruffled edges with thick pale midribs, slightly glossy and wilted, piled in a loose mound on the upper left of the plate, roughly 9 cm across and 2 cm tall, with a few thin reddish-purple stems tucked beneath | 70
ITEM 2 | Small round tan-to-golden grains, slightly glossy and clustered, with scattered dark dried fruit pieces and a few darker specks mixed through, forming a mound about 9 cm across and 3 cm tall on the upper right | 190
ITEM 3 | Yellow squash and green zucchini pieces, cut into irregular wedges and chunks about 3 to 4 cm long, with golden-brown edges and light char in places, soft and slightly glossy, clustered at the lower left | 120
ITEM 4 | Sliced meat, dark reddish-brown on the outside with greyish-brown cut edges, sliced into thin overlapping pieces about 0.5 cm thick, arranged in a fan shape about 6 cm long on the lower right, with a small smear of juices and a few grains beside it | 75
